Operating expense reductions are attributed to lower gas purchase costs (S5-S6), while wage increases are noted (S7). Balance sheet items (S13-S17) show logical movements tied to reported profits and financing activities. The legal provision (S18) and dividend approval (S19) are presented as separate, non-conflicting facts. No arithmetic contradictions exist because the summary never claims exhaustive additivity between segment figures. Organization is clear with progressive disclosure of results, drivers, and balance sheet effects.
